The '''''Stinky Bantha''''' was an [[Action IV transport]].

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Cularin Militia]], borrowed the ''Bantha'' from an unknown person. The [[Heroes of Cularin]] flew it on a mission to the [[Thaereian system]] to rescue some prisoners from there. They docked it with the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Burnout (space station)|''Burnout'']] and brought the prisoners back to it, before flying them back to the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]].
